title: The Basin and River Balance Canon
summary: The school canon of a basin kept level and a river kept to its measure so that every surge and drought is made even.

title: The Dual-Track Crown of Accord
summary: The school's high course of two tracks of opposing force that meet at the crown in a single lasting accord.

title: The Wind-Sworn Mean Canon
summary: The school canon of the mean sworn to the wind that gives no ground to the gale and no ground to its absence.

title: The Oath Beneath the Level
summary: The school's deepest oath sworn to the bedrock level beneath all rise and fall and loosed upward as a settling of the world.
